label: Lower when belief favours S1 or after choosing a1; deepest at D1 after a1 reached S2.
explanation: The update gate z of unit 28 stays near 1 (about 0.99) and dips below its timing baseline in proportion to the ideal observer belief that S1 is good (saturating tanh of the log-odds). The dip is about twice as large at GO and in the last episode decile, where the gate varies most. Having chosen a1 on the previous trial lowers it further, again more in the last decile. On top of that there is a sharp extra dip at D1 right after an a1 trial that reached S2 (a rare transition), rewarded or not, and it is largest when unrewarded. With belief negative (S2 favoured) or after a2 the gate rises slightly above baseline. Future variables (this reward, the next choice) are not needed. The free fit (separate phase and decile terms plus the choice two trials back) adds little: dev 0.578 vs 0.562 for the short form. The remaining misses are long late-episode runs of a1 choices where the gate drops more than predicted, which points to slow accumulation of a1 choices.

issues: The claims hold. On test, removing the late-decile and GO multipliers lowers R^2: plain tanh(belief) + D1*a1*S2 + a1 gives 0.448, adding (1+GO) gives 0.501, adding (1+ep_dec9) on belief gives 0.547, and the full recorded form gives 0.554. The D1 a1->S2 dip is real: the profile residuals are a1 S2 u -0.028 and a1 S2 r -0.015, against about 0 for D1 a1 S1 r.

The label leaves out reward. Misses on the recorded short form systematically over-predict after unrewarded previous trials: GO after a1 S1 u -0.007, D1 after a1 S1 u -0.005, GO after a1 S2 u -0.005. They under-predict after rewarded ones: D1 after a1 S2 r +0.006, D1 after a1 S1 r +0.006. Changing the a1 term to (prev_action==1)*(1+(prev_reward==0))*(1+(ep_dec==9)) raises test R^2 from 0.554 to 0.573 and removes most of that pattern.
'After choosing a1' is not uniform. At D1 after a1 S1 r the residual is about 0 (+0.0004), so the a1 dip mostly follows unrewarded or rare trials.
The label does not mention that the belief and a1 effects roughly double in the last episode decile. The short form encodes this and it is load-bearing (0.501 -> 0.547 on test).

Large errors remain in long late-episode (t92-99) runs of a1 choices, where the gate falls to about 0.85-0.88 and the prediction is about 0.93-0.95. This is the agent's own stated residual. Smooth late-episode ramps (exp(ep_trial/10 or 20)) scored worse (0.44 and 0.50), and adding the a1 choice two trials back did not help (0.554).
skeptic.revised_label: Lower when belief favours S1 or after unrewarded a1 trials, more so late; deepest at D1 after a1 reached S2.
